name: whisper-small-komixv2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-small (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of openai/whisper-small, not a new base model: same config.json, 0.242B parameters against the base record's 0.244B - a rounding or label difference, not extra weights, and the tensor set is the base's. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. No licence tag on the repo, repo created 2025-02-27. The evaluation table is inherited from rtzr/Awesome-Korean-Speech-Recognition and holds a row for every whisper size; base = the whisper_small row of that same table.
